summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Fashion Retail Gap Analysis Platform filtering functionality with Salesforce theme. All backend filter APIs working correctly, frontend filter panels functioning properly across all pages with correct page-specific filters, active filter count badge working, and Salesforce blue theme properly implemented.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 'No data matches the selected filters' when using date filters outside data range

passed_tests: Backend filter options API endpoint returns correct structure
Filter toggle button expands/collapses filter panel with animation
Active filter count badge shows correct count and updates dynamically
Date range filters populate and function correctly
Category multi-select shows options and allows multiple selections
Channel multi-select shows options and functions properly
Region multi-select shows options and works correctly
Reset Filters button clears all filters
Apply Filters button triggers data refresh and collapses panel
Gap Analysis page shows threshold filters (understock/overstock sliders)
Core Logics page shows min size filters (input and percentage slider)
BI Dashboards page shows only common filters (no page-specific thresholds)
Salesforce blue theme applied to sidebar and primary buttons
Filter panel animation works smoothly on expand/collapse
IBM Plex Sans font implemented for body text
Chivo font implemented for headings
CSS custom properties for Salesforce theme properly configured
Multi-select dropdowns support Ctrl+click functionality
Filter parameters correctly passed to backend APIs
All analytics endpoints accept and process filter parameters
